# image-size 2.0.4

Unmodified `dist/esm` modules and MIT license from the pinned npm package.
The conversion worker uses the public `imageSize(Uint8Array)` API to check
dimensions before requesting browser pixel decoding. Parsing and decoding both
remain inside a cancellable worker. The filesystem entry point is not imported.
